verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is a developer-facing skills and plugin package for agents, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows static README and SKILL.md command snippets, such as `yy ledger create`, plus CLI install instructions. Nothing shows an interactive API reference or runnable in-browser examples, and the docs-md probe returned a 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
